biotools.summary: RNAhub is a web server that facilitates RNA structural and evolutionary studies by automating the retrieval and alignment of homologous RNA sequences. The tool takes an RNA sequence as input, retrieves homologous sequences, and assesses whether the query RNA sequence has a conserved RNA structure.
